asks: Of what goes to an allowed host, where does the record keep the content and where only the size?
answer: An allowed host is still a way out. The record keeps what was sent in the model traffic Silo reads. For everything else it keeps only the sizes, also where Silo puts a secret in.

sets.says: The record shows what was sent for the model traffic Silo reads, and the sizes for everything else, not only which hosts were reached.
